doc: The 🌿 ground panel's vocabulary — authoring conveniences only: every option is applied as a concrete terrain/grass verb on a deliberate click, so the log never stores one of these names and logged meaning never depends on this file. `tints` pair a terrain layer colour with the seasonal recolor each blade species takes (the two grass keys differ because the sheets are authored in different hues — the meadow sheet is already green so it keeps its own art (null), while bunch grass ships a straw recolor and only the `green` recolor brings it back). `shapes` are terrain amplitudes; `grassHeight` doubles as the wind response (lawns are stiff, tallgrass sways); `grassDensity` is kept modest — blades are fill-rate. A planting is one bag on the singleton grass verb; `blade: true` plantings take the height dial and a tint colour (the `tint` key names which column of the tint row applies).
